source.name: Spark of Courage
source.description: Carrier deals +25% damage to enemies level higher than or equal to carrier.

descriptions.en: Carrier deals +25% damage to enemies level higher than or equal to carrier.
descriptions.ru: Наносит +25% урона врагам чей уровень не ниже уровня носителя.
descriptions.zh-cn: 携带者对等级不低于自己的敌方棋子造成的伤害+25%。
descriptions.zh-tw: 攜帶者對等級不低于自己的敵方棋子造成的傷害+25%。
